Neither the birthday doc nor any other names the upgrade tool.
- Hop P2 -> P3 (**state-derived**): the tier rules' own sentence "worked out only after every dispatched order … within the missing-points request window carries its earning entry". Records show `20f92fdd…` lacking one. Searching "earning entry dispatched order missing points" reaches the fulfilment-order desk note and the missing-points requests doc; the order is the reservation's recorded fulfilment order -> fulfilment desk note's write ("The agent posts one missing-points adjustment entry").
- Order: P3 -> P2 -> P1. P3 is weight-bearing for P2: without it the window spend is 154.00 × 1.05 + 20.00 = 181.70 -> Member.
- Counter-proof "do only the one thing asked": claiming now at Member gives 0 -> "no birthday bonus is posted"; computing the tier without the fulfilment order leaves Member as "the tier its tier-qualifying spend has reached", which is excluded only because the tier rules say that tier "is not yet worked out" while an in-window dispatched order lacks its earning entry. Excluded by visible sentences + records.
- Other counter-proofs: the shopping boost uses the tier held on the claim date (Silver 1.25), not Member; spend window is 12-month (23 months, not 24); the 2025-07-28 refund falls outside the 12 months, so the store-credit relief tier is "every one paid as a new Return Store Credit".
